shared_prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one final full-size portrait woodcut tarot card for CosyWorld. Image 1 is the owner's small card, supplied as the design, composition and COLOR reference. Redraw its composition, figures, objects, corner emblems, foliage, number plate and name plate as a richly detailed hand-carved woodcut print at exactly 1024 by 1536 pixels, portrait 2:3. Draw crisp new carved contours and fine hatching instead of enlarging the tiny crop. Preserve dense near-black ink, warm aged cream paper AND the relevant suit's spot color from the source: periwinkle-blue moths, deep-teal bells, olive-green buttons or terracotta-orange lanterns, including the associated interior accents listed below. Keep vermilion red for scarves where named. The World carries all four suit accents. Both card backs keep their original cream/black palette because they have no single suit. Keep light natural paper grain, irregular hand-printed ink edges, calm folk woodcut character, readable graphic silhouettes and bold serif capital lettering. One complete flat front-on card fills the opaque canvas; every rounded cream corner and full border stays visible. No perspective, surrounding table, cast shadow, hands holding the card, extra text, invented symbols, gradients, photorealism, metallic decoration, collage or watermark. Follow the specific composition and color placements below.

assets.name: The Lover
assets.prompt:
VI THE LOVER. Preserve the curly-haired young man standing in the center between a bearded person at left and a woman at right. The left person touches his shoulder; the right woman reaches toward his open hand as they draw him two ways. Small winged Cupid flies above, aiming a bow and arrow rightward. A tiny temple sits on a hill at upper right and a forked path curves below. Four moth emblems in the corners and ivory leaf sprigs at the sides. Top plate exact text: VI. Bottom plate exact text: THE LOVER. All clothes are plain cream and black. NO scarf and NO red anywhere.
Color placement: Use periwinkle blue for all four moth corner emblems. Keep Cupid, all three figures, temple, paths and foliage cream and black. No scarf or red.

assets.name: The Chariot
assets.prompt:
VII THE CHARIOT. Preserve the close three-quarter view of a steam train moving toward the right. The adult driver, wearing a plain railway cap and rolled-sleeve shirt, leans from the cab window at upper right with one hand on the sill. A rounded locomotive boiler extends toward left; a thick plume of pale steam curls above; strong diagonal rails run across the lower foreground. Four bell emblems at the corners, small leaf sprigs at the upper sides. Top plate exact text: VII. Bottom plate exact text: THE CHARIOT.  No scarf or red.
Color placement: Use deep teal for the four bell corner emblems and the railway rails, as in the original. Train, driver, steam, foliage, lettering and border remain cream and black. No scarf or red.

assets.name: Justice
assets.prompt:
VIII JUSTICE, Marseille order. Preserve the solemn woman facing directly forward behind a balanced set of scales. Her two hands rest at equal height on the beam; the upright post stands in the center. A complete key rests in the left pan and a closed sealed envelope rests in the right pan. Her plain cloak crosses the shoulders with one round brooch. Four moth corner emblems and upper leaf sprigs. Top plate exact text: VIII. Bottom plate exact text: JUSTICE. Keep the beam level and pans balanced.
Color placement: Use periwinkle blue for the woman's shoulder cloak and all four moth corner emblems. Keep her face, hands, balanced scales, key and envelope cream and black. No scarf or red.

assets.name: The Wheel of Fortune
assets.prompt:
X WHEEL OF FORTUNE. Preserve the tall old steam clock on rough mossy stones, round dial in its upper half, thin clock hands, tick marks without Arabic digits. Its open lower case reveals two hanging weights and three interlocking toothed gears. Bent pipes run down the right side; a small bell hangs to the left; pale steam curls at upper left. Four oil-lantern corner emblems and upper leaf sprigs. Top plate exact text: X. Bottom plate exact two-line text: WHEEL OF on the first line, FORTUNE on the second, matching the reference. No extra THE.
Color placement: Use terracotta orange for all four lantern corner emblems and the small clock hands, matching the original. Clock body, bell, pipes, weights, gears and steam remain cream and black. No scarf.

assets.name: Strength
assets.prompt:
XI STRENGTH, Marseille order. Preserve the woman at left gently tending the hurt front paw of the large calm wolf at right. She cradles the paw in her lower open hand and carefully removes a small curved thorn with the other. The wolf lowers its head toward her; ears and long muzzle remain recognizable. Intimate close composition, kind focused expression. Four small oil-lantern corner emblems, upper leaf sprigs. Top plate exact text: XI. Bottom plate exact text: STRENGTH.  No scarf, blood, wound detail or gore.
Color placement: Use terracotta orange for all four lantern corner emblems and the small curved thorn being removed. Figure, wolf and paw remain cream and black. No scarf, blood or gore.

assets.name: The Hanged Man
assets.prompt:
XII THE HANGED MAN, the traditional Marseille tarot allegory of contemplation. Depict a calm adult acrobat in a cream tunic and leggings performing a safe inverted aerial pose beneath a broad tree branch. One ankle is secured in an aerial support loop; the other leg bends across the straight leg, exactly as the conventional tarot emblem. Both hands rest comfortably behind the torso. The head is far above still water and the face is peaceful. Nothing touches the neck; no danger, injury, distress or self-harm. Below, gentle ripples reflect a small dark standing person in a pale band of light. Preserve the source composition and four bell corner emblems. Top plate exact text: XII. Bottom plate exact two-line text: THE HANGED on the first line, MAN on the second. No scarf or red.
Color placement: Use deep teal for all four bell corner emblems and the still-water ripples. Figure, branch, support loop and reflection remain cream and black. No scarf or red.

assets.name: The Nameless Card
assets.prompt:

A pair of empty boots rests at lower left. Behind it a small old steamer waits on still dark water. Preserve the reference's exact relative placement and corner emblems. The scarf is the only red. The skeleton is a symbolic carved-print figure, no corpse, blood, gore or text about death. Top plate exact text: XIII. The entire cream bottom name plate must remain COMPLETELY BLANK: no name, letters, dots, symbols or ornament inside that plate. Do not write DEATH, THE NAMELESS CARD or XIII in the bottom plate.
Color placement: Use deep teal for all four bell corner emblems and the small water ripples under the steamer. Keep the cut scarf vermilion red. Skeleton, robe, scythe, ship and empty boots remain cream and black. Keep the entire bottom name plate blank.

assets.prompt:

Two smaller fully clothed adult people at lower left and right hold loose ropes attached to the box; loops are visibly loose enough to slip free. The box stays closed, is the pedestal, and has a round front lock. Four round four-hole button corner emblems and leaf sprigs. Top plate exact text: XV. Bottom plate exact text: THE DEVIL. No scarf or nudity. Neutral folklore illustration.

At center, a lone tall round-topped open doorway stands in the shallows; its opening stays black, with a few pale steps visible inside. Willow branches hang along both upper sides. A small complete oil lantern stands on the near bank at lower left, its pale reflection leading into the water. Four bell corner emblems. Top plate exact text: XVIII. Bottom plate exact text: THE MOON.

assets.prompt:

Below the mast is a low building with a broad multi-pane window; a row of many adult listeners seen from behind gathers in silhouette across the foreground and looks upward. Four oil-lantern corner emblems and leaf sprigs. Top plate exact text: XX. Bottom plate exact text: JUDGEMENT, spelled J-U-D-G-E-M-E-N-T.

assets.name: The World
assets.prompt:

A long vermilion-red scarf flies diagonally across the torso and outward on both sides. A small cottage with two lit windows stands on a rise inside the ring at lower right. Match the source's four corner emblems: bell at upper left, moth at upper right, round four-hole button at lower left, oil lantern at lower right, in their original suit colors. Top plate exact text: XXI. Bottom plate exact text: THE WORLD. Only the scarf uses vermilion red.
Color placement: Preserve all four suit colors in the four different corner emblems: deep teal bell at upper left, periwinkle-blue moth at upper right, olive-green button at lower left, terracotta-orange lantern at lower right. Cottage windows use terracotta orange. The flying scarf is vermilion red. Dancer, oval wreath, lettering and frame remain cream and black.

assets.name: Star back
assets.prompt: STAR CARD BACK. Recreate the supplied owner's complete woodcut tarot back, perfectly balanced with 180-degree rotational symmetry. Preserve the cream rounded outer border, black inner field, three concentric cream rings around a central black disc holding TWO cream four-pointed stars. Preserve the large moth at the top and its rotated counterpart at the bottom, bell flowers and leafy sprigs in all four corners, and paired curling vines between them. No number plate, no name plate, no lettering anywhere. Black and warm cream only, no red or other colors. Flat printed card front-on, entire border and rounded corners visible.
